notes.title: NEW KICKSTARTER - Winter Heat, Starting August 1st
notes.content: [p][b]Coming to [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]Kickstarter[/url] on August 1st![/b][/p][p][i][b]Winter Heat[/b][/i] [b]is more than a love story. It’s the texts, notes, games, and digital worlds of a couple across years of their lives.[/b] This wholesome visual novel chronicles a modern romance in a uniquely digital way.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/Winter_Heat"][/dynamiclink]Javiera Vera is a freelancer living in the sweltering summer of Maipú, Santiago, in Chile. Fukkoshi Shio is an office worker living in the snowy rural town of Miyazu, Kyoto, in Japan. Though they live on different sides of the world, they share something that transcends all boundaries: an internet connection.[/p][p][b]How will their friendship deepen during one special December? Find out through the apps Javi and Shio use every day.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/5648a0b293f3a94e2e279c9fc28620a34d607737.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re raising finishing funds for [i]Winter Heat[/i] to help expand the game further and further. Not only will we have an extensive main story, but we’ll also have a boatload of in-story “apps.” Some are educational, some flesh out the characters, some are even full-fledged minigames.[/p][p]More Kickstarter backers means more in-universe apps to explore and even more content for the main storyline. Back the campaign to follow our progress…[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/df1176ca6d6703cd3c29633b4d6ccb9f485b2c21.png"][/img][/p][p]…and let Javi and Shio’s story unfold.[/p][h3][b]Digital Love with Digital Apps[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/40a688196b5171ee99c19b133b0dc2b4d1a19fd5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/42bc29eedbee022c4951d3cb60f6fc08e024c951.png"][/img][/p][p]Enjoy the classic late 00s browser-based kid-friendly MMO [b]Froguelike[/b] in special flashback chapters \[Game not actually playable]! See how Javi and Shio first met as young teens, and how they reunited after many years apart.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/4c6ed99f28686afbfb8870c0d16e0da6792e83dd.png"][/img][/p][p]Learn more about Javi and Shio’s towns through the [b]Maps[/b] app. Find out the best spots in Kyoto and Santiago, the local haunts, and plan your inevitable Yuri Tourism trip.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/a24a24d98d1d2ecc5b513d507433f0f4dbd9e14d.png"][/img][/p][p]With the [b]Wittier[/b] app, find Javi and Shio online—along with trolls and other weird strangers. Then smash keywords together to post engagement bait. Can you rack up 10,000 followers?[/p][p]We’re working on many more apps as well, and with your crowdfunding support, we can make them better and better. And, with stretch goals, we’ll even add brand-new apps![/p][h3][i][b]Welcome to Oomfie RPG[/b][/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/786ea3c062d97f2f4521a0f8dd77394ab1b93c3c.gif"][/img][/p][p]But of course, our most important app is a full-fledged sub-game: [b]Oomfie RPG![/b][/p][p]Each copy of [i]Winter Heat[/i] comes with a ROM of one of Javi and Shio’s favorite nostalgic games (and pieces of riffing material): [i]Oomfie World IV: The 1994 Saga of Turbo[/i]. Why does the title include “1994”? We’re not sure. Probably because that sounded futuristic in 1993.[/p][p]After her best friend Sam is sucked into the hot new game console, Oomfie must traverse the digital world of Turbo and collect pieces of the Virtual Cuboid Console to send them both back.[/p][p]Discover a comfy town and four mazelike adventure zones, switching from a classic overhead view to first-person face-offs in the Chili Forest and other whimsical locales.[/p][p][b]Every run through an adventure zone is different, with its own special events.[/b] Meet friends and not-so-friends on the road, and decide whether to trade, help, or run away really fast. The further you go, the more forks in the road.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/435287335654a7682c77d2c7d89e660281e654b9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Then oomf your way through tricky turn-based batles.[/b] Use Action Points to attack, but watch out: your AP is also your health! Healing at the right moments and reading your opponents’ moves are the keys to victory.[/p][p]You have space for eight moves…and items. Together. Will you pick up a weapon, or a healing hamburger? [b]Make tough choices on the road,[/b] and pray that the merchant has a good selection.[/p][p]Only your customized Oomfie can beat all four adventure zones and save the day![/p][h3][b]And You’ve Gotta Help![/b][/h3][p]Oomfie is counting on you to support [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]our Kickstarter when it launches on [b]August 1st[/b][/url]! We’ll also be launching a [b]brand-new demo[/b] on Steam and Itch so you can try out the new apps and the Oomfie RPG.[/p][p]We’re overjoyed to show the world this game that’s so close to our hearts.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Kickstarter link: [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Steam link: [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/Winter_Heat"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/Winter_Heat[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Itch link: [/p][p][url="https://yuri-kissaten.itch.io/winter-heat"]https://yuri-kissaten.itch.io/winter-heat[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Press kit: [/p][p][url="https://yurikissaten.com/winter-heat-press-kit/"]https://yurikissaten.com/winter-heat-press-kit/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Visit our site: [/p][p][url="https://yurikissaten.com"]https://yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Follow on Bluesky: [/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com"]https://bsky.app/profile/yurikissaten.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Subscribe on Youtube: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@yurikissaten"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Support on Patreon: [/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten"]https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.01 Patch Notes + Japanese Localization
notes.content:
We've updated [i]Love is in the Airship[/i]. There is now a Japanese localization available, plus some minor updates in advance of the bigger content update coming soon.

[list]
[*] Added Language Switch. Switch in the settings menu or the main menu!
[*] Language should automatically be set based on your system language,
[*] Added Japanese language,
[*] Updated credits,
[*] When clicking on Auto-Foward button, a message on the top left will display telling you it has been toggled.,
[*] Skip Unread Text is now turned off by default,
[*] Adjusted skip button to be gray when you are unable to skip.,
[*] Fixed typo in Intro ("theirchance to get onto the Tibarn."),
[*] Fixed typo in Bar visit 1 ("dreamsare"),
[*] Fixed window graphic not appearing when inputting name,
[*] Fixed bug where player name will not be renamed to "You" if you make your name blank,
[*] Fixed "Triangle" achievement not triggering if you do the "Horns and Umbrellas" route,
[*] In the demo, fixed bug where it would lead to "Do something" action which wasn't supposed to be there
[/list]

notes.title: Visual Novel Fest Sale
notes.content:
[i]Love is in the Airship[/i] is on sale on Steam for the Visual Novel Fest! It's 20% off from now until March 10th at 10 PM PDT. If you haven't picked the game up yet, this is its biggest sale yet, and it'll be the biggest price drop for the game for a while. If you have picked the game already, this is the perfect St. Patrick's Day, Mar10 Day, or Pi Day gift for your friends, loved ones, and rivals.

As we said in the previous announcement post, [i]Love is in the Airship[/i] is going to receive a content update pretty soon, probably in mid-May. If you liked the hidden secrets buried throughout the game, you're going to love digging for even more brand-new scenes when this content update comes out. We're also releasing one brand-new romanceable character route--a secret for now, but that character will be revealed very soon!

notes.title: Yuri Kissaten Patreon Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162870/fe332dbca4c9bcae19a412b68bb8d1e92313a479.png[/img]
Hey y'all! It's been over four months since [i]Love is in the Airship[/i] released, and we'll be giving you the heads up on Yuri Kissaten's plans for 2025. They are wildly ambitious, way too busy, and something you ought to follow as closely as you can.

First things first, I'd like to tell you that we're preparing the first big Love is in the Airship content update. Y'all said the best thing about this game is the hidden depth and myriad of secret story paths, so we're planning on delivering you even more things to discover. New scenes, new endings, new art, and most importantly... [b]A new romanceable character path![/b] We have a few new romance paths in the works, but the first one will be included in this upcoming update.

You'll be very excited about who we chose... Trust me. Leave your guesses in the comments below so we can see how accurate you were.

With added complexity means a lot of inevitable bugs, though. With time for testing and implementation, the new content update should be out probably in mid-May. But don't be shocked if it comes out a little late, or even a little early. 

There's also a Japanese translation in the works. I guess not many reading this will be super enthused about that, but people at the upcoming Game Pavilion event in Osaka sure will be.

And then, for the main announcement:

[h1]Yuri Kissaten has a Patreon![/h1]

We launched a [url=https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten]Patreon[/url] a couple weeks ago, and it's going very strong. Our theme for this year is the [b]5 for '25 Campaign[/b]--we're developing five brand-new full-fledged games in 2025, and trying to complete most of them.

It's obviously going to be a big challenge. Our games work off very small budgets with only a couple of developers each, which means we have to be efficient and creative as possible to make quality video games in a short timespan. And working on several titles at once? You'd think we're nuts. We're not--we're just extremely energized to deliver you some giga-good games.

You can support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/yurikissaten]Patreon[/url] by becoming a free or paid subscriber. Free subscribers can read monthly updates on what we're up to across our 5 for '25 Campaign, and paid subscribers get access to bonus updates with extra-early sneak peaks at our games, as well as candid, honest posts about our path to becoming a real-deal full-time game development studio. You'll also get early builds of some titles!

2025 is going to be an incredible year for Yuri Kissaten, and we're happy to have you along.

And if you're a [i]Love is in the Airship[/i] fan, just know we have a whole lot more where that came from.
